title: The Dark Marketing Agency That Used Dead People's Voices in Ads
hook: An ad firm scraped audio from funeral home recordings and used AI to sell products using the deceased's voice.
why_this_can_go_viral: Extremely morbid and unethical, guaranteed to provoke shock and shares across moral outrage communities.

title: The Startup That Sold 'AI Financial Advisors'—They Were Gambling Addicts in a Basement
hook: A fintech startup promised AI-powered stock picks — it was actually a room of recovering gamblers using gut feelings.
why_this_can_go_viral: Irony and deception in the AI hype era — people love behind-the-scenes scams.

title: The Dark Marketing Firm That Used Ring Doorbells to Spy on Neighbors for Ads
hook: A marketing company bought access to Ring cameras and used footage to sell hyper-targeted ads based on your daily routine.
why_this_can_go_viral: Privacy outrage is a massive driver — everyone with a smart doorbell will feel violated and share.

title: The Supply Chain Secret of 'Wild Honey'—It Was Corn Syrup Fed to Bees in a Warehouse
hook: That 'raw wild honey' you bought? It came from millions of bees locked in a warehouse and fed only corn syrup.
why_this_can_go_viral: Health-conscious consumers will be horrified — the visual of bee cruelty is highly shareable.

title: The Industry Cover-Up of 'Lead-Free' Paint—It Was Loaded with Lead, Just Labeled Differently
hook: A major paint manufacturer labeled lead-based paint as 'lead-free' by using a loophole in testing methods — children got sick.
why_this_can_go_viral: Direct harm to children triggers strong emotional response and moral outrage.

title: The Corporate Spy Who Stole a Microchip Design by Replacing a Cleanroom's Air Filters
hook: A rival company replaced the HEPA filters in a chip fab — the new ones collected airborne silicon dust, revealing the chip layout.
why_this_can_go_viral: Highly technical and clever — appeals to tech enthusiasts and espionage lovers.

title: The Dark Marketing Firm That Used Airport Wi-Fi to Play Subliminal Ads on Phones
hook: A marketing company injected subliminal audio into airport Wi-Fi networks — passengers heard ads they didn't know they heard.
why_this_can_go_viral: Fear of hidden manipulation is universal — extremely shareable among privacy-concerned audiences.

title: The Supply Chain Secret of 'Organic' Avocados—They Were Grown in a Fracking Zone
hook: That 'organic' avocado came from a farm that used fracking wastewater to irrigate — and radioactive particles ended up in the fruit.
why_this_can_go_viral: Health and environmental fears combine — avocado lovers will be horrified and share.

title: The Industry Cover-Up of 'Shredded' Wheat—It Was Sawdust and Glue
hook: A cereal giant replaced wheat with treated sawdust and glue in its shredded wheat — and hid it for a decade.
why_this_can_go_viral: Childhood nostalgia + food fraud = explosive share potential.

title: The Trader Who Faked a 'Chemical Spill' to Destroy a Rival's Factory Stock
hook: A commodities trader secretly released a non-toxic dye into a river near a rival plant — then tipped off media about a 'toxic spill.'
why_this_can_go_viral: Real-world sabotage with a financial motive — feels like a thriller plot.

title: The Startup That Sold 'AI Art Generators'—They Were Stolen Images from Dead Artists
hook: A startup claimed its AI created original art — it was actually a database of paintings stolen from deceased artists' estates.
why_this_can_go_viral: Artist community outrage + AI skepticism = perfect viral blend.

title: The Monopoly That Bought All the Insulin Pump Patents—Then Made Diabetes a Money Printer
hook: A healthcare conglomerate bought every insulin pump patent — then forced diabetics to pay $5,000 for a $50 device.
why_this_can_go_viral: Massive public anger over drug pricing — diabetics and their families will share widely.

title: The Spy Who Stole a Battery Formula by Replacing a Lab's Fume Hood Filters
hook: A corporate spy replaced the fume hood filters in a battery lab — the old ones were analyzed to reverse-engineer the electrolyte.
why_this_can_go_viral: Incredibly clever method — appeals to engineering and true crime crossover audiences.

title: The Dark Marketing Firm That Used Alexa Recordings to Sell You Things You Never Mentioned
hook: A marketing company bought access to Alexa voice data — then played you ads for products you only talked about in your living room.
why_this_can_go_viral: Everyone who owns a smart speaker will feel targeted — massive paranoia-driven shareability.

title: The Supply Chain Secret of 'Fair Trade' Cocoa—It Was Grown on a Military Compound
hook: That 'fair trade' chocolate bar came from cocoa grown by forced labor on a military base — the 'certification' was fake.
why_this_can_go_viral: Ethical consumption betrayal — activists and conscious consumers will amplify.
